season.evidence: Ascent histogram: Jul 77, Aug 36, May 9. WebSearch (NPS climbing blog, SummitPost, Cascade Climbers snippets): glacier straightforward with few open crevasses in July; July is a workable window. Stored Jul-Sep kept; May ascents dropped as off-season.

track.why: Peak has exactly one stored route; logged 'South Face (L5)' on 19 Jul 2026, summited (14 m from our summit pin), line goes up the south side from a camp near the Redoubt Glacier. It is a camp-to-summit-to-camp loop (about 3 mi, 2,000 ft), not trailhead-based, so it is neither a full round trip nor trailhead-to-summit; the apply script decides.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 10 Jul 2018 summit, camp-based track near the high camp, no logged route or report.

facts.text: In early July the fast ford of Depot Creek near 5,100 ft is best crossed where the stream splits into several channels; one party lost a pole there.
In early July the lower Redoubt Glacier is broken up; the flatter upper part gives easier travel.
On the south side the first snow finger tempts parties onto slabby, loose rock; go past one more ridge to the real steep snow finger and the gully above it.
Above the cannonhole turn left; the last 50 ft or so to the summit is steep enough that a handline was used.

notes: Only one stored route and it is the standard south route. No pins proposed (stored trailhead is the Depot Creek washout in BC; not re-confirmed this session). Most Redoubt ascents in the log are July Chilliwack-group trips.
